purpose: Test whether 9/21 EMA Crossover, Breakout from Consolidation, Pullback to 21 EMA, and Oversold Bounce (RSI<30) contain stable conditional substructure that survives dependence-aware discovery and genuinely unseen validation. Written before any discovery result for this batch was inspected.
excludedReason: Already have completed Conditional Edge Discovery research histories (2026-08-22 discovery run + dependence audit). Not rerun in this batch.

9/21 EMA Crossover.priorResearchQuestion: Is positive expectancy concentrated in particular trend/volatility/security-momentum states, or broadly distributed?

Breakout from Consolidation.priorResearchQuestion: Do breakout outcomes depend materially on volatility, volume, prior trend, market regime, or relative strength in a way that survives OOS?

Pullback to 21 EMA.priorResearchQuestion: Does the weak positive baseline expectancy contain a materially stronger conditional subset that survives validation?

Oversold Bounce (RSI<30).priorResearchQuestion: Is the stronger apparent expectancy stable enough to condition further, or too weak once effective-N and adaptive-search corrections are applied?

engineComponents.featureSnapshots: engine/pit_features.py -- point-in-time, unchanged from prior audit

featureUniverse.note: No new features/thresholds/datasets added for this batch; discoveryEligible:false features (calendar, sector) remain excluded from candidate generation exactly as before.

engineComponents.clustering: engine/conditional_dependence.py -- overlap_block clustering for these per-symbol strategies (rebalance_cluster does not apply; none of these four are cross-sectional)

split.purgeRule: drop training rows whose exit falls at/after the next window opens minus embargo

nullCalibration.method: cluster-preserving outcome shuffle, original (dependence_aware=False) pipeline replayed

engineComponents.freezeGate: effective-N (cluster-based) projected onto validation-slice cluster count, not raw retained rows
engineComponents.holdoutPolicy: sealed; opened only if validation passes; opening is ledger-recorded before results are read

constraintsDeclaredInAdvance: No new indicators, thresholds, datasets, or strategy-specific handcrafted features.
No cross-strategy retroactive selection of the 'best-looking' candidate as though preregistered -- each strategy is its own research family.
No holdout use to rescue a failed validation; a sign-reversed effect fails outright.
No fold-result retuning of walk-forward candidates.
Do not modify Conditional Edge engine unless a genuine bug blocks execution; if found, stop the affected strategy, document, fix with a regression test, rerun only what the fix invalidated.
acceptableOutcomes: Interesting discovery evidence, insufficient validation power
